crossRefs.note: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
crossRefs.keyword: violent man. Heb. man of violences

crossRefs.note: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
